messages:
alice-m: Pushed a tiny Next.js + LangChain starter for the eval harness. Repo: https://git.internal/redwood/next-eval-starter

ben-p: Nice. Does it show server-side auth proxy? New devs always leak the API key to the browser.

alice-m: Yep. Example in /pages/api/redwood.js:

```js
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const r = await fetch(process.env.REDWOOD_API_URL + '/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` },
    body: req.body,
  })
  res.status(r.status).send(await r.text())
}
```

danielle-k: Love it. Can we show SDK retry config? People expect exponential backoff + jitter.

alice-m: Added a small helper and docs. Snippet:

```js
import { Redwood } from 'redwood-js-sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, retry: { retries: 3, factor: 2, minTimeout: 100 } })
```

ben-p: Make sure parity with Python sample. Last time JS had a helper and Python did manual loops.

alice-m: Good call. TODO in repo to sync examples across languages.

emily-s: Also added a streaming example for Next.js pages using fetch readable streams. Shows cancellation when user navigates away.

alice-m: CI note: added GitHub Actions job that uses a repo-scoped secret and creates a temp user key so the eval harness runs on first fork. CONTRIBUTING.md updated.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for branch next-eval-starter — build #4822 started :rocket:

ben-p: One more: add troubleshooting for 401 vs 403 from proxy (missing ENV vs wrong scope). People paste 401s to #help constantly.

alice-m: Will add. If folks want write access ping me. :thumbsup:
